capabilities: insert citations via an @ trigger as wikilinks or zotero:// links
complete equations, theorems, and figures from the current paper via a ;; trigger
import a meaningful paragraph with its equations by semantic search
track the current paper in Zotero and search the library
create and link literature notes for papers
extras: Desktop-only. Warns that 'Extract paper' uploads the PDF to MinerU's servers, so don't extract PDFs you can't share with a third party; Voyage also receives block text unless the local Ollama backend is used. Optional companion pieces (Zob Bridge, an MCP server) live in the same repo and must be built and installed separately.
problem: While reading a paper in Zotero, Obsidian offers no way to pull in its citations, equations, theorems, or figures as you write.

relations.evidence: reads the paper you're reading, metadata, fulltext, and annotations from Zotero's local API
a Zotero plugin adding live tab tracking, current page, and selected annotations
your PDF is uploaded to MinerU's servers to extract equations/theorems/figures
Ollama — local, no key, no rate limits, offline
Voyage — cloud, free tier; sends block/query text to Voyage to embed

summary: Zotero integration that provides context-aware completions in Obsidian: citations, equations, theorems, and figures from the paper open in Zotero.
